basic_details.short_information: NTPC Limited (A Govt. of India Enterprise) is hiring one Specialist (Project Management) on a fixed term of 03 years for its Gas Engine based power project at Great Nicobar Island (GNI), at a monthly consolidated amount of Rs. 5,00,000/- plus Company accommodation/HRA, retention benefit and medical facility. Candidates need a minimum of 20 years of post-qualification experience, at least 3 years of it in project planning/execution/monitoring/management. Applications are accepted only online at careers.ntpc.co.in from 6 November 2026 to 20 November 2026 (till 06 PM) under Advt. No. 16/26.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 57 years. Age, experience and qualification are counted with reference to the last date of receipt of online application, that is 20 November 2026.

qualification.details: B.E / B.Tech in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation & Control OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with two-year MBA / PGDM | All qualifications should be full time from Universities/Institutions recognized and approved in India.

selection_process: To restrict the number of candidates
to conduct a multi-stage selection process which may comprise application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification/percentage of marks
number of years of required post-qualification experience etc.)

or a combination of these. It may also raise the minimum eligibility standards. Meeting the minimum eligibility does not give a candidate the right to be shortlisted or called for a written test or interview. The selected candidate must clear the NTPC medical examination before joining.
how_to_apply: Log on to careers.ntpc.co.in between 6 November 2026 and 20 November 2026 (till 06 PM). Only online applications are accepted; no other mode is accepted.
Keep a valid email ID; NTPC is not responsible for bouncing of any email sent to candidates.
Pay the application fee if you are in the General/EWS/OBC category (details below) and enter the payment details in the online form.
Upload all documents listed below while applying; applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected.
After applying, download the application slip with the unique application number generated by the system and keep a copy. No document is to be sent to NTPC by post.

Offline payment: Take a printout of the pay-in-slip available on the application portal to a nearby SBI branch. The fee goes into a specially opened account, A/C No. 30987919993 at CAG branch, New Delhi (Code: 09996). The bank issues a unique Journal Number and Branch Code, which must be filled in the online application. Only the pay-in-slip printed from the portal should be used; NTPC is not responsible if the fee is deposited in the wrong account.
Online payment: Net banking, Debit Card or Credit Card, through the online application form.
Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates should verify their eligibility before paying.
Class X passing certificate/Marksheet, PAN Card and Aadhar Card (Name and DOB should match on all documents).
Final/Provisional certificate in the required Engineering Discipline/MBA/PGDM and Graduation (as applicable).
Consolidated Marksheet/Transcript/all semester marksheets showing aggregate % of marks, for Graduation and Post Graduation as applicable.
Marks conversion formula from the university/Institute for converting CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into percentage.

Caste/Disability certificate (for EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD candidates) as applicable; OBC-NCL certificate in central format for FY 2026-27; EWS Income & Asset certificate valid for FY 2026-27 based on the income of FY 2025-26.
Disability certificate in the latest central Govt. format, generated online through the Swavalamban/UDID portal, showing the type and percentage of disability.

Experience documents for each organisation placed together in chronological order: Experience/Service certificate (in NTPC prescribed sample format), Offer of Appointment/Appointment letter/Offer Letter plus Confirmation/Absorption Letter, Joining Order, Role Assignment orders, Promotion and Transfer orders, Organization charts, 02 pay slips for every year and Form-16 for each organization.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Specialist (Project Management) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a fixed selection procedure or any date for a test or interview.

rows.details: NTPC Limited (A Govt. of India Enterprise)
Gas Engine based Power Project at Great Nicobar Island (GNI)
Rs. 5,00,000/- a month (consolidated), plus Company accommodation/HRA, retention benefit and medical facility
Minimum 20 years post-qualification, at least 3 years in project planning/execution/monitoring/management
Great Nicobar Island (GNI); posts are transferable
May include shortlisting/screening, written/computer-based test and personal interview

content_sections.heading: About NTPC
content_sections.text: NTPC Limited, a Government of India Enterprise with its registered office at NTPC Bhawan, SCOPE Complex, 7, Institutional Area, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003, describes itself in the notice as India's largest power conglomerate with an installed capacity of over 91 GW, and says it plans to reach a total installed capacity of 149 GW by 2032. For these growth plans it is looking for a senior level experienced professional on a fixed term basis for the Gas Engine based power project at Great Nicobar Island.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Specialist (Project Management) Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NTPC has advertised one post of Specialist (Project Management), reserved as follows. Reservation for PwBD candidates is as per Govt. Guidelines. The notice calls the vacancies projected: they may increase or decrease as per organizational requirement at the discretion of NTPC management, and the Company reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail or increase the number of vacancies without further notice. a) D, HH b) OA, OL, Dw, AAV, SD/SI* (SD/SI without any associated neurological/limb dysfunction; SD/SI with associated limb dysfunction is covered under the respective sub-category such as OA, OL) c) SLD, MI d) MD involving (a) to (c) above Disability conditions falling under the category "likely to improve" under temporary disability are not eligible for PwBD reservation.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.E / B.Tech in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation & Control OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with two-year MBA / PGDM All qualifications should be full time from Universities/Institutions recognized and approved in India. Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience Out of this, at least 3 years should be in project planning/execution/monitoring/management Preference shall be given to candidates who are familiar with the geographical conditions of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and are conversant with local regulations, statutory requirements, environmental norms and safety standards. Experience in setting up large projects from scratch in coastal forest areas will be an added advantage. The upper age limit is 57 years. Age, experience and qualification are counted with reference to the last date of receipt of online application, that is 20 November 2026. The notice allows the following relaxation where there is a vacancy identified for such category: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Candidates claiming a category must hold the applicable year's valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/Disability certificate from the Competent Authority in the latest prescribed format of Govt. of India. Before joining, the selected candidate must pass a medical examination by the NTPC Medical Board/Officer, whose decision is final; no relaxation in prescribed health standards is allowed. Detailed medical norms are on careers.ntpc.co.in. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact discipline-wise eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration: Monthly consolidated amount of Rs. 5,00,000/-. Additionally: Company accommodation/HRA, retention benefit and medical facility for self, spouse, dependent parents and two dependent children. Tenure of engagement: 03 years, on a fixed term basis. Place of posting: Great Nicobar Island (GNI) for the Gas Engine based Power Project. Posts are transferable to any of NTPC's Offices/Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries, based on organizational requirements and at the sole discretion of the Management. The notice does not mention any extension or renewal of the 3-year term.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NTPC Specialist (Project Management)
content_sections.text: Log on to careers.ntpc.co.in between 6 November 2026 and 20 November 2026 (till 06 PM). Only online applications are accepted; no other mode is accepted. Keep a valid email ID; NTPC is not responsible for bouncing of any email sent to candidates. Pay the application fee if you are in the General/EWS/OBC category (details below) and enter the payment details in the online form. Upload all documents listed below while applying; applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected. After applying, download the application slip with the unique application number generated by the system and keep a copy. No document is to be sent to NTPC by post. Offline payment: Take a printout of the pay-in-slip available on the application portal to a nearby SBI branch. The fee goes into a specially opened account, A/C No. 30987919993 at CAG branch, New Delhi (Code: 09996). The bank issues a unique Journal Number and Branch Code, which must be filled in the online application. Only the pay-in-slip printed from the portal should be used; NTPC is not responsible if the fee is deposited in the wrong account. Online payment: Net banking, Debit Card or Credit Card, through the online application form. Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates should verify their eligibility before paying. Class X passing certificate/Marksheet, PAN Card and Aadhar Card (Name and DOB should match on all documents). Final/Provisional certificate in the required Engineering Discipline/MBA/PGDM and Graduation (as applicable). Consolidated Marksheet/Transcript/all semester marksheets showing aggregate % of marks, for Graduation and Post Graduation as applicable. Marks conversion formula from the university/Institute for converting CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into percentage. Caste/Disability certificate (for EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD candidates) as applicable; OBC-NCL certificate in central format for FY 2026-27; EWS Income & Asset certificate valid for FY 2026-27 based on the income of FY 2025-26. Disability certificate in the latest central Govt. format, generated online through the Swavalamban/UDID portal, showing the type and percentage of disability. Experience documents for each organisation placed together in chronological order: Experience/Service certificate (in NTPC prescribed sample format), Offer of Appointment/Appointment letter/Offer Letter plus Confirmation/Absorption Letter, Joining Order, Role Assignment orders, Promotion and Transfer orders, Organization charts, 02 pay slips for every year and Form-16 for each organization.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: To restrict the number of candidates, NTPC management reserves the right, if required, to conduct a multi-stage selection process which may comprise application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification/percentage of marks, number of years of required post-qualification experience etc.), a written/computer-based test, a personal interview, or a combination of these. It may also raise the minimum eligibility standards. Meeting the minimum eligibility does not give a candidate the right to be shortlisted or called for a written test or interview. The selected candidate must clear the NTPC medical examination before joining.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NTPC Advt. No. 16/26?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Specialist (Project Management), in the UR category; NTPC says the number may increase or decrease as per organizational requirement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NTPC Specialist (Project Management) post?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 20 November 2026 (till 06 PM); applications opened on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: B.E / B.Tech in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation & Control, or a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with two-year MBA / PGDM, full time from a recognized Indian university or institution.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: A minimum of 20 years of post-qualification experience, of which at least 3 years should be in project planning/execution/monitoring/management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 57 years, counted on the last date of online application, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL and 10 years for PwBD where a vacancy is identified for that category.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of NTPC Specialist (Project Management)?
faq.answer: A monthly consolidated amount of Rs. 5,00,000/-, plus Company accommodation/HRA, retention benefit and medical facility for self, spouse, dependent parents and two dependent children.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General/EWS/OBC candidates pay a non-refundable Rs. 500/-; SC/ST/PwBD/XSM and female candidates need not pay.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online only at careers.ntpc.co.in, upload all required documents and download the application slip; no document is to be sent by post.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NTPC Specialist post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a fixed term engagement with a tenure of 03 years.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidate be posted?
faq.answer: At Great Nicobar Island (GNI) for the Gas Engine based Power Project, but the post is transferable to any NTPC office, station, project, JV or subsidiary at the Management's discretion.
